name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.CallingPageNativeTransActivity
description: When a BNC GIMAC call is sent to the background, this Activity keeps the call page linked to its floating video window and restores the call when the user returns. It also updates the window as the call changes.
disableEffect: Disabling it can stop the call from staying available in a floating window when the user leaves the call screen.
